summary: iter-401 (Mid-Treatment Implant Addition) — backend fully verified with 10/10 pytest cases: in-charge auto-approve happy path (implants/plans/missing_teeth/torque_values all extended, augmentation & addition_reason persisted, added_in_phase=3), student→supervisor→in-charge chain (pending_supervisor → pending_incharge → approved, implants only appended on final approve), decline path (never appended), and validations (Single case → 400, completed status → 400, duplicate site 16 → 400, invalid FDI 99 → 400, nurse → 403, non-treating student → 403, missing iopa_url → 422, missing reason → 422). Phase-4 pending flag: without ISQ → pending_stage2_verification=true on both implant & implant_plans; with ISQ → false. Frontend E2E verified: after seeding an approved addition via API for site 26, /procedures/{id} renders (a) the [data-testid=add-implant-section] card, (b) an approved request row [data-testid^=implant-addition-req-] with 'Approved — added to case', (c) the new implant tile shows the 'Added in Phase 3' chip [data-testid^=implant-plan-added-], (d) Torque Values Achieved lists Implant 2 = 40 Ncm alongside the original 35. Regression: NO add-implant-section rendered on a 'Single Conventional Implant' case. Modal opens on click, tooth dropdown (36) works, system dropdown loads 69 catalog options + Other, aug Yes/No toggle present, reason textarea works — visible in captured screenshot. Automation stopped short at the PlacementDatePicker (no [data-testid^=date-day-] on DOM) and the IOPA file chooser sheet — these are automation-selector gaps, not user-facing bugs; the API path is 100% green.

ui_bugs.issue: Console prints ~150× 'Encountered two children with the same key' warnings when the tooth catalog dropdown and system-catalog dropdown open (both use option strings as key; system catalog has duplicate labels e.g. two identical brand — system entries). Fix: use index-suffixed keys `${opt}-${idx}` or dedupe the option list in getImplantSystemOptions().

No `data-testid="date-day-<YYYY-MM-DD>"` emitted on calendar day cells → external test harnesses (and the review-request spec) cannot pick a placement date. Please add a stable testID per selectable day.

After [data-testid=add-implant-iopa-btn] is clicked a modal 'Choose Files' text appears but there is no data-testid on that picker option, so page.expect_file_chooser flow (the one described in the review request) times out. Please add [data-testid=add-implant-iopa-choose-files].

TextInputs at lines 141 & 158 use JSX prop `data-testid="login-email-input"/"login-password-input"` without a matching `testID` — RNW does not forward `data-testid` on <TextInput>. Add `testID={...}` alongside so future test scripts don't have to fall back to placeholder selectors.

action_items: Dedup / index-key the option lists rendered inside AddImplantSection Dropdown to remove the 'duplicate key' React warnings (functional but noisy).
Add data-testid `date-day-<YYYY-MM-DD>` to each selectable day cell in PlacementDatePicker so the review-request UI flow can be fully automated.
Add data-testid to the IOPA 'Choose Files' picker sheet option (e.g. `add-implant-iopa-choose-files`).
Add matching `testID` prop to the login TextInputs so login-email-input / login-password-input are addressable via data-testid on RNW (pre-existing minor issue).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2461-2506 (_apply_implant_addition) uses `datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()` for added_at but `datetime.utcnow()` for updated_at — mix of naive vs aware datetimes, standardise.

server.py:2547 uses `_resolve_active_implants_inline(proc)` and filters `_active_in_treatment is not False` — good — but the duplicate-site check does not account for added-then-declined implants that were never appended; verified by test (declined path leaves implants[] unchanged), so no bug, just note that the pending-site guard on line 2550 correctly considers pending_supervisor + pending_incharge but treats 'approved' requests as 'active' via the implants[] scan (no double-counting).
AddImplantSection.tsx Dropdown at lines 40-49 uses `key={opt}` — will collide when system catalog has repeated labels; switch to `key={\`${testID}-${idx}\`}`.
server.py add-implant validation currently returns HTTP 400 for the FDI check, HTTP 422 (pydantic) for max_length; consistent — no change needed.

success_rate.frontend: 90% — feature user-visible & data-testid coverage OK on the section, request row, and 'Added in Phase' chip; automation gaps on date picker & IOPA picker (not user-facing)
